# War Scroll Column 19 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 19 | **Condition:** heavily damaged

---

**1** [...] they will rise [...] the champion of war [...] and the gates [...]

**2** [...] You have given strength [...] Your hand [...] over the nations [...]

**3** [...] You have [com]manded us [...] through our generations [...] Your amazing acts [...] and

**4** Your justice [...] You have done amazing things for the humble [...] and for those tested by fire [...]

**5** [...] You have shown Your power [...] in the night [...] and at dawn [...]

**6** [...] because of the greatness of [...] the covenant with [...] our ancestors [...]

**7** [...] the community of the holy ones [...] the glorious [...] in the gathering of [...] knowledge [...]

**8** [...] the mighty ones of [...] justice [...] and the marvel of [...] Your glory [...]

**9** [...] the works of [...] Your hand [...] the nations of [...]

**10** [...] just judgment [...] the assembly of Your faithful people [...] the chosen [...]

**11** [...] we have celebrated [...] Your unfailing love [...] and Your deliverance [...]

**12** [...] Your powerful arm [...] has never retreated [...] for all [...]

**13** [...] the seasons of Your glory [...] the gathering of [...] truth [...]

**14** [...] for all time, forever [...]

---

*PNEUMA notes: Column 19 is the final, most heavily damaged column. The victory hymn concludes with praise and thanksgiving. "Champion of war" for gibbor milchamah. "Humble" for 'aniyyim (the poor). "Unfailing love" for chesed. "Ancestors" for avot. This marks the end of the War Scroll.*
